# Comparator setup

* `comparator.json` names the compared theorems: `theorem_5_1`, `theorem_5_1_tendsto`,
  `theorem_5_1_unique` (Theorem 5.1), `theorem_5_2`, `theorem_5_2_deterministic`
  (Theorem 5.2) and `proposition_5_3` (Proposition 5.3), all in namespace `WeakPathwiseIto`.
* `WeakPathwiseItoComparator/Challenge.lean` is generated by `scripts/gen_challenge.py`:
  the import closure of `Main.Theorem51`, `Main.Theorem52`, `Main.Proposition53` flattened,
  one `section` per source module, with the auxiliary-lemma cache reset at each module
  boundary so `_proof_N` names match the per-module library build. It imports Mathlib and
  the vendored libraries under `vendor/` (part of the submission) that the copied modules
  import — currently `BrownianMotion.Gaussian.BrownianMotion` (`VENDOR_PREFIXES` in the
  generator). As in `catskillsresearch/scott_models`, vendored libraries are compiled as
  lean_libs of this package (`srcDir = "vendor/<pkg>"` in `lakefile.toml`), not as Lake path
  dependencies, so a Comparator build writes only under `.lake/`. Proofs are copied as written, never replaced by `sorry`. Theorems/lemmas (and
  `**Subgoal**` helper defs) that are neither compared nor referenced by anything kept are
  commented out completely (`/- [omitted from the Challenge: …] … -/`), so they add no
  declarations.
* `WeakPathwiseItoComparator/Solution.lean` imports the `WeakPathwiseIto` library.
* Checks: `bash scripts/compare_challenge_solution_types.sh` (types of compared names, plus
  the strict closure check `scripts/compare_challenge_solution_strict.sh`),
  `python3 scripts/check_module_name_clash.py`, and the full toolkit
  `bash scripts/palomar_preflight.sh --mechanical-only`.
* Blueprint stage: the library proofs are `sorry`, so Palomar mechanical verification
  (no `sorry` in Solution's closure) is expected to fail until the holes are closed.
